guide.containerPrep: Clean the container with warm water (no soap) and ensure it is fully dry before starting.
guide.separation: Add a thin layer of [[sphagnum|sphagnum moss]] or fine mesh over the [[drainage-layer|drainage layer]] to prevent substrate mixing.
guide.charcoal: Add {depth} of [[horticultural-charcoal|horticultural charcoal]] over the separation layer to keep the build fresh.
guide.substrate.custom: Add {depth} of your custom mix: {recipe} — {article} {character} blend.
guide.substrate.standard: Add {depth} of a standard well-draining terrarium mix.
guide.placement: Plant the tallest or deepest-rooted plants first: {names}.
guide.placement.fast: Note: {names} grow fast, so leave extra room around them.
guide.watering: Based on these plants' needs, {mode} the terrarium.
guide.seal.sealed: Seal the container completely and place in indirect light for 48 hours to stabilise.
guide.seal.lidded: Close the lid, but crack it open briefly each day for the first week to allow gas exchange.
guide.seal.open: No sealing needed. Monitor [[humidity]] closely during the first week.
guide.light.conflictLowMed: Conflicting light needs: some plants need direct sun, others prefer low or medium light. Place in [[bright-indirect|bright indirect light]] as a compromise — watch sun-lovers for [[etiolation]] and shade plants for bleaching.
guide.light.conflictBright: Direct and bright-indirect light requirements conflict. Place in [[bright-indirect|bright indirect light]]. Direct sun through glass can trap dangerous heat in an enclosed container.
guide.light.mixedBright: Mixed light needs. Position in medium-bright indirect light — slightly further from the window than optimal for the bright-indirect plants to protect low-light ones.
guide.light.mixedLow: Mixed low and medium light needs. A medium-low indirect light spot works well — a few feet back from a bright window.
compat.light.lethal: {a} needs {aLight} light and {b} needs {bLight} light — direct sunlight through glass creates a greenhouse effect and will cook shade-adapted plants — lethal.
compat.light.secondaryOnly: {a} prefers {aLight} light; {b} prefers {bLight} — they overlap only on a secondary (tolerated) light level.
compat.light.oneStep: {a} prefers {aLight} light; {b} prefers {bLight} — one step apart, manageable.
compat.light.twoStepDirect: {a} needs {aLight} light; {b} needs {bLight} — light needs are two steps apart — a risky mismatch.
compat.light.tooFar: {a} needs {aLight} light but {b} needs {bLight} — their light needs are too far apart.
compat.humidity.noOverlap: {a} needs {aMin}–{aMax}% humidity; {b} needs {bMin}–{bMax}% — humidity needs don't overlap, incompatible.
compat.moisture.survival: {a} likes it {aMoist} soil but {b} prefers {bMoist} — in one shared substrate, one plant will struggle.
compat.moisture.secondaryOnly: {a} prefers {aMoist}; {b} prefers {bMoist} — they overlap only on a secondary (tolerated) moisture level.
compat.moisture.oneStep: {a} prefers {aMoist}; {b} prefers {bMoist} — one step apart, manageable with care.
compat.moisture.twoStep: {a} prefers {aMoist} soil but {b} prefers {bMoist} — one plant may struggle.
compat.temp.noOverlap: {a}: {aMin}–{aMax}°C; {b}: {bMin}–{bMax}°C — their temperature ranges don't overlap, incompatible.
compat.ph.survival: {a} needs {aPh} substrate and {b} needs {bPh} — no single substrate can be both acidic and alkaline — one plant will struggle regardless of care.
compat.ph.oneStep: {a} prefers {aPh} substrate; {b} prefers {bPh} — one band apart. A near-neutral mix keeps both within tolerance.
compat.container.closed: {plant} needs airflow, so it is not suitable for a closed or lidded terrarium.
compat.container.open: {plant} prefers humid conditions — may struggle in an open container.
compat.crowding.error: {count} plants share only {area} cm² of floor — overcrowded, they'll compete for root space.
compat.crowding.caution: {count} plants share {area} cm² of floor — tight, monitor for overcrowding.
compat.gasExchange: {plant} grows fast and may deplete CO₂ quickly in this micro sealed container.
